scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check services && uv run ruff format --check services
scripts.typecheck:py: cd services/veritas && uv run mypy && cd ../indexa && uv run mypy
scripts.test:py: uv run pytest services/veritas && uv run pytest services/indexa
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm lint:py && pnpm typecheck:py && pnpm test:py
scripts.contracts:generate: tsx scripts/export-contracts.ts && uv run --no-sync ruff format services/indexa/src/indexa/contracts.py
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/core/schemas services/indexa/src/indexa/contracts.py
